020import com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.shop.Shop;
021import org.bukkit.Location;
022import org.bukkit.entity.Player;
023import org.bukkit.inventory.ItemStack;
024import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
025
026/**
027 * A generic class representing a PacketFactory that can create packets of type T. This class can be
028 * extended to provide specific implementations for creating packets based on different versions or
029 * criteria.
030 *
031 * @author creatorfromhell
032 * @since 6.2.0.9
033 */
034public interface PacketFactory<T> {
035
036  /**
037   * Creates a spawn packet for the specified ID and display location.
038   *
039   * @param id              the ID of the packet to be created
040   * @param displayLocation the display location where the packet will be spawned
041   *
042   * @return the spawn packet of type T
043   */
044  T createSpawnPacket(final int id, @NotNull Location displayLocation);
045
046  /**
047   * Creates a metadata packet with the specified ID and ItemStack.
048   *
049   * @param id        the ID of the metadata packet to be created
050   * @param itemStack the ItemStack to include in the metadata packet
051   *
052   * @return the metadata packet of type T
053   */
054  T createMetaDataPacket(final int id, @NotNull ItemStack itemStack);
055
056  /**
057   * Creates a text display spawn packet for the specified entity ID and location.
058   *
059   * @param id        the unique identifier for the entity associated with the text display spawn packet
060   * @param location  the location where the text display will be spawned, cannot be null
061   * @return          the text display spawn packet of type T
062   */
063  T createTextDisplaySpawnPacket(final int id, @NotNull final Location location);
064
065  /**
066   * Creates a packet to toggle the visibility of a text display entity.
067   * This packet is associated with the specified entity ID, includes
068   * the provided item stack.
069   *
070   * @param id        the unique identifier of the entity whose visibility is being toggled
071   * @param itemStack the item stack associated with the text display, must not be null
072   * @return          a packet of type T that toggles the visibility of the text display
073   */
074  T createTextDisplayVisiblePacket(final int id, final @NotNull Shop shop, final @NotNull ItemStack itemStack);
075
076  /**
077   * Creates a velocity packet with the specified ID.
078   *
079   * @param id the ID of the velocity packet to be created
080   *
081   * @return the velocity packet of type T
082   */
083  T createVelocityPacket(final int id);
084
085  /**
086   * Creates a destroy packet for the given ID.
087   *
088   * @param id the ID of the packet to be destroyed
089   *
090   * @return the destroy packet of type T
091   */
092  T createDestroyPacket(final int id);
093
094  /**
095   * Sends the specified packet to the given player.
096   *
097   * @param player the player to receive the packet, cannot be null
098   * @param packet the packet of type T to be sent, cannot be null
099   *
100   * @return true if the packet was successfully sent, false otherwise
101   */
102  boolean sendPacket(@NotNull Player player, @NotNull T packet);
103
104  /**
105   * Registers the method to listen to the packet sending chunk data.
106   */
107  void registerSendChunk();
108
109  /**
110   * Unregisters the method to listen to the packet sending chunk data.
111   */
112  void unregisterSendChunk();
113
114  /**
115   * Registers the method to listen to the packet sending the unloading of a chunk.
116   */
117  void registerUnloadChunk();
118
119  /**
120   * Unregisters the method to listen to the packet sending the unloading of a chunk.
121   */
122  void unregisterUnloadChunk();
123}
